assertions.assertion: Uses UseSmtpOtpDispatcher() inside the AddUserManagement options lambda
assertions.rationale: `options.UseSmtpOtpDispatcher(...)` is placed inside the AddUserManagement(options => { ... }) lambda in the shown Program.cs.
The dispatcher sets smtp.Host = "smtp.example.com" and smtp.Port = 587.

assertions.assertion: Configures from address for outgoing emails
assertions.rationale: smtp.FromAddress = "noreply@example.com" is set (and included in the bound config section).

assertions.assertion: Does NOT use ConsoleOtpDispatcher for production (or warns against it)
assertions.rationale: A dedicated section explicitly warns that ConsoleOtpDispatcher is development-only and must not be used in production.
